text: Reminder: Thursday's stall rota still isn't finished. Can everyone reply with a slot by Monday? Mornings 8:30-11, afternoons 14:00-16:30 at the gate table
Afternoon works for me. Mornings I'm on site until noon so no
I can take the 8:30 cash box if nobody else wants it

(👍 2)
Good, then mornings are sorted. I'll do 14:00 gate if still open
can i do afternoon?? last lesson ends 13:50 so i can get there and do we get the cashbox key from u konstantina or the office
Afternoon for Electra, yes. Key is with the office, Konstantina will confirm
Thursday I teach until 13:00. I can do 14:00 onward if the gate needs a second person
So mornings still have no second person
I'll bring the float and do the cash box on my own in the morning, it's fine
[photo: poster draft]
Konstantina are you sure? I can come 9-10 if you want company
Yes, I'll be there. Just put me down
Has anyone got the number for the company that does the lights for last year? Stall lights are on the list but nobody has the contact
I think the lights were Lumen Events last year? Checking my email
Yes it was Lumen. Here's the contact from the invoice email 👍
[screenshot: email from Lumen Events, Nov 2025]
Do they want a deposit or do we pay after
Paid after last year, invoice came in January. It's in the treasurer folder
Sorry, was marking. Thursday 14:00 gate, put me down. What time do the lights go on
Dusk, about 16:15 in December. Who sets the timer
Konstantina, can you do the timer at 16:00 when you're closing the cash box? Or I can
ok so the cashbox key is at the office till 14:00?? can i collect it at lunch or does someone have to come with me
Office shuts at 13:30 Thursday. I'll ask them to leave it with the caretaker and you sign for it. Stavros can you be there when she collects?
Yes, I'll be by the gate at 13:45
ty
Lumen last year was 340 euro
Does 340 include cable hire or just the lights
Lights only. Cable was separate, I'd have to check the invoice
is the rota done or nah
nvm found it in the group pinned msg lol
Checked the lights invoice. Cable was 85 euro, separate from the lights. It's in the folder with the rest
So budget is 355 for lights plus cable if they charge again. I'll call Lumen today and get the quote confirmed
Did we ever settle the float amount?
Konstantina I'm free 9-10 Thursday after all, so I'm coming. 🙂
Ok thank you. Float is 200, I'll count it at home Wednesday
[photo: stall map with the gate table marked]
Stall 6 doesn't seem to have a power point. Can someone check before Thursday?
I'll walk round at lunch. The sockets by 6 were on the east wall last year
just finished. key pickup thursday at 1:45 right? do i bring my student card or
Student card, and sign the book at the caretaker's desk. Stavros will be there
ok ty!!
Socket by 6 is dead. The electrician's in on Wednesday for the hall lights, I'll ask him to look at it
Called Lumen. Same package is 355 this year. They need a number by Wednesday or the slot goes to someone else
Shall I just confirm?
Yes please Kostas. Invoice goes to the bazaar account, Konstantina pays it
Yes confirm it. Send me the invoice when it comes and I'll pay from the bazaar account
Confirming then
omg we need more cable ties 😭 there's like 4 left in the drawer. someone bring some??
I have a bag in the shop, I'll bring it Thursday
Did anyone book the gate trestle or do we set it up ourselves?
Set it up ourselves. The caretaker leaves the trestle in the hall. I'll move it at 13:45
